NO FURTHER INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED. A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED WHEN THE MANUFACTURER¿S INVESTIGATION IS COMPLETED.

THE PATIENT STATED HAVING OCCASIONAL LOW FLOW WITH SUBOPTIMAL PI PARAMETERS OVER TWO OR THREE DAY PERIOD. THE PATIENT EXPLAINED WORKING OUTSIDE FOR SEVERAL DAYS. THE PATIENT'S PUMP SPEED WAS REDUCED. BLOOD MEASUREMENTS WERE 105/72 WITH MEAN ARTERIAL PRE
NO FURTHER INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED. A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED WHEN THE MANUFACTURER'S INVESTIGATION IS COMPLETED.
